cohort: Near-term/term neonates (>=35 weeks' gestation, birth weight >= 2000 g) from Southern China with transcutaneous bilirubin levels > 40th percentile within 72 hours of birth, comparing those with and without HDN.
finding: Early postnatal end-tidal carbon monoxide (ETCOc) levels were strongly associated with an increased risk of hemolytic disease of newborn (HDN) in neonates.
